instruction: Create empty file named 'placeholder.txt' in each of directories 'dir1', 'dir2', 'dir3'.

parameters.command: rm -rf dir1 dir2 dir3 && mkdir dir1 dir2 dir3

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'for d in dir1 dir2 dir3; do if [ -f "$d/placeholder.txt" ]; then echo "Success: placeholder.txt exists in $d."; else echo "Failure: placeholder.txt does not exist in $d."; fi; done'
